title: Slay Spirit Fish
author: Consistent-Candy6434
selftext:
Link: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5494360/Slay\_Spirit\_Fish/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5494360/Slay_Spirit_Fish/)

Focusing on a Counter + Rhythm-based combat system similar to *Sekiro*. Essentially, there will be a few main playstyles:

1. **The Apathetic Cultivator:** Ignoring worldly affairs, focusing purely on slaying spiritual fish and aquatic beasts to restore one's power and ascend.
2. **The Meddling Senior (Interfering with Karma):** Akin to protagonist tropes in cultivation novels who possess overwhelming strength compared to ordinary mortals. Living in seclusion, a single word or pointer from you can skyrocket someone's cultivation, change the destiny of a family, or rewrite the fate of a kingdom.

**In-game Example:** While you are busy slaughtering a Spiritual Fish, an old man and an injured young woman suddenly flee toward you, with an arrow flying straight at her. You are presented with several choices:

1. **Save them:** Release your aura to deflect the arrow (Costs 3 Sols).
2. **Ignore them:** Do nothing (0 Sols).
3. **"Those who step into my territory shall be executed without mercy."**

* *If you choose Option 3 (Kill anyone who enters your domain):* The old man suddenly leaps in to shield the blow and dies. Simultaneously, a talisman flies out at the last second, allowing the young woman to vanish and escape (the talisman only activates upon the old man's death). Result: +1 grudge against a certain sect or aristocratic family, leading to endless future troubles.
* *If you choose Option 1 (Save them):* You inadvertently make an enemy of the pursuing assassins. However, you can still resolve this: the moment they catch up, don't waste words—annihilate them instantly using your most devastating methods so they have no time to send a distress signal. Alternatively, you can spend all your remaining Sols to release an overwhelming wave of pressure, intimidating them so thoroughly that they never dare set foot near you again (though doing so will gradually leak your identity, attracting even fatter "sheep" \[enemies/challengers\] looking for trouble).

... and countless choices for effortless "face-slapping" and flexing.
